summary: Bay Minette police booked a man on a sex-offender registration charge Friday, and sheriff's deputies made two domestic-related arrests. The jail roster shows 13 criminal bookings dated Oct. 30 and 2 so far on Oct. 31; Charvez Lavon Gonzales, booked Oct. 29 on robbery and drug charges, remains in custody.

entries.title: Sex offender registration arrest: Zackary Sabastian Kimmell
body: Zackary Sabastian Kimmell, 33, was arrested by Bay Minette police at 4:30 p.m. Friday, Oct. 30, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on a charge of failure of an adult sex offender to register with local law enforcement or comply with residence restrictions — the rules on reporting and where a registered offender may live. He was in custody when the roster was read Saturday morning.

entries.title: Family-violence arrests: Dalton Ellis Luker, Ashley Nicole Thornton
body: Sheriff's deputies made two arrests on domestic-related charges Friday, Oct. 30, according to the jail roster.

Dalton Ellis Luker, 24, was arrested at 6:38 p.m. and booked on a charge of interference with a domestic violence emergency call — stopping someone from calling for help — along with two counts of failure to appear on a felony and first-offense drug paraphernalia. Ashley Nicole Thornton, 36, was arrested at 12:37 p.m. and booked on a charge of harassment of a family or household member. Both were in custody when the roster was read Saturday morning.

entries.title: Evidence-tampering arrest: Shannon Gene Pickard
body: Shannon Gene Pickard, 50, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 11 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 29, and booked into the county jail Friday, Oct. 30, according to the jail roster.
He was booked on charges of tampering with physical evidence — destroying or hiding evidence — and obstructing governmental operations. The roster shows him released Oct. 30.

entries.title: Cocaine and property-damage arrests: Patric Jordan Landrum, Freddie Demetrius James
body: Patric Jordan Landrum, 34, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 3:48 a.m. Saturday, Oct. 31, and booked on charges of cocaine possession and first-offense drug paraphernalia, according to the jail roster.

Freddie Demetrius James, 42, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 2:46 a.m. Friday, Oct. 30, and booked on charges of criminal mischief — damaging another person's property — and public intoxication. Both were in custody when the roster was read Saturday morning.

entries.title: Robbery arrest: Charvez Lavon Gonzales
body: Charvez Lavon Gonzales, 26, was arrested by sheriff's deputies Thursday, Oct. 29, according to the jail roster, which gives no arrest time.

He was booked on charges of robbery listed as "street, other weapon" — taking property by force or threat outside a home or business, with a weapon other than a gun or knife — and possession of dangerous drugs. He was still in custody when the roster was read Saturday morning. The sheriff's office has not posted details of the arrest.

entries.title: Elder abuse arrest: Zoe Ocean Nolau
body: Zoe Ocean Nolau, 27, was arrested by Silverhill police at 5:53 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 29, according to the jail roster.

She was booked on a charge of second-degree elder abuse and neglect — abuse or neglect of an elderly person causing injury. She was still in custody when the roster was read Saturday morning. Police have not released further details.

entries.title: Firearm theft arrest: Brandon Matthew Donovan
body: Brandon Matthew Donovan, 37, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 3 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 29, according to the jail roster.
He was booked on a charge of theft of a firearm. The roster shows him released the same day.

entries.title: Drug possession arrests: six booked Oct. 29
body: Sheriff's deputies booked four people Thursday, Oct. 29, on drug-possession charges, according to the jail roster: Holly Kate Collins, 49 (two counts of possession of dangerous drugs); Amber Lee Meredith, 40 (possession of dangerous drugs, illegal possession of prescription drugs and drug paraphernalia); Eric Steven Broadus, 49 (possession of dangerous drugs and drug paraphernalia); and Timothy Bryan Heaton, 55 (possession of dangerous drugs). Broadus was released Oct. 30, according to the roster; the other three were in custody when it was read Saturday morning.

Orange Beach police arrested Sean Michael Tedder, 40, and Armista Michelle Saldana, 38, at 7:53 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28; both were booked Oct. 29. Tedder was booked on marijuana and paraphernalia charges and released Oct. 29; Saldana on possession of dangerous drugs and released Oct. 30.
"Possession of dangerous drugs" is the jail's term for possessing a controlled substance; the roster does not name the drug.

entries.title: School threat arrest: Foley High School student
body: Foley police said a Foley High School student was arrested Thursday, Oct. 29, after a report of a weapon on campus. Police searched several areas in and around the school and did not find a firearm, according to the department's account reported by FOX10 and NBC 15.
Police did not name the student or state the charge. Police said the case is being referred to the Juvenile Court of Baldwin County.
